notes: Save your Workshop setup to show it on your car in Ranked Racers and racer profiles after the next snapshot.

entries.title: Fix Achievements and Style Shop loading
notes: Fixed Achievements and the Style Shop not opening after an update.
Paid styles in Racer Studio now open their exact Shop listing. The live preview leaves more room for your racer details.

entries.title: Expand achievements and the Style Shop
notes: Achievements now show 44 tiers, including new rewards for Ranked Extra finishes, personal bests, and verified wins. The Style Shop has eight new items, and live previews have more room.

entries.title: Fix archived names and track freshness
notes: Past Events now use the latest available racer names, and track boards show the age of their own standings. The Center sticker sits farther forward, and the update button is easier to spot.

entries.title: Restore the latest past weekly event
notes: Uplink Error is back in the Past Events list, in the right order. Saved standings are shown without labeling them final.

entries.title: Keep event results when name filters change
notes: Improved name filtering for event standings. A filtered name does not remove a race time or change their event points.

entries.title: Group Beat the Owner under Style
notes: Beat the Owner is now a challenge in the Style path. The goal details are shorter, and you can still open previews of eligible tracks.

entries.title: Clarify snapshot updates and Workshop placement
notes: The update button now pops into view, and snapshot notices tell you how many racers, tracks, and race times are new. Selecting Center or Flat rear for a sticker now turns the Workshop camera to that area.

entries.title: Show new results in snapshot updates
notes: Snapshot notices show the new racers, track boards, and playable results since the previous snapshot.

entries.title: Announce new ranking snapshots in game
notes: Ranking snapshots now have their own update screen with the racer, track board, and playable result counts.

entries.title: Restore published replays before ranking updates
notes: Rankings keep playable results and no longer wait for new runs whose replay files are missing.

entries.title: Publish rankings while pending previews wait
notes: New rankings can publish while unavailable replay previews wait for their own checks.

entries.title: Keep published ranking boards during refresh
notes: Ranking updates keep the last published track results visible while a newer board is being checked.

entries.title: Batch ranking snapshot reconciliation
notes: Ranking snapshots can reconcile track results in batches, so changed replays take less time to process.

entries.title: Prioritize required boards for ranking updates
notes: Rankings updates prioritize the track boards needed for Overall rankings.

entries.title: Keep saved Workshop styles on personal replays
notes: Your saved Workshop paint and stickers now follow your car into personal replays, including older event replays.

entries.title: Quarantine only changed recordings in routine snapshots
Omit invalidated boards from routine snapshot publication
Defer changed recordings without blocking snapshot capture
Refresh Kodub rollover and compact snapshot history
notes: The Kodub weekly card can switch tracks and artwork without reloading, even before the static files catch up.
Official and Community podium rankings show the actual top podium finishes in that scope.

entries.title: Bound manual canonical recovery reads
notes: Manual snapshot recovery can reconcile more previously published runs without raising scheduled read limits.
